canonical_identity.title: Mundari TTS dataset corpus
canonical_identity.related_publication: MunTTS: A Text-to-Speech System for Mundari
canonical_identity.publication_venue: Proceedings of the Seventh Workshop on the Use of Computational Methods in the Study of Endangered Languages (ComputEL-7), 2024, pp. 76-82

provider_reported_metadata.full_corpus_access: provider directs users to request a download link by email

publication_crosscheck.note: Repository README reports 26,870 audio files while the 2024 paper reports 26,868 recordings. Preserve this two-record discrepancy as an unresolved version/count issue; do not normalize or fabricate a resolution.

provenance.repository_statement: Corpus created by Microsoft Research India, IIT Kharagpur and Karya, with FAIR Forward/GIZ collaboration.
provenance.publication_artifact_relation: Microsoft MunTTS repository is related software/publication infrastructure and must not be counted as an independent underlying speech corpus without provenance evidence.

rights_and_ethics.license: Non-commercial Karya Public License; repository instructs users to consult LICENSE.txt.

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: README, LICENSE.txt, COPYRIGHT.txt, data-sample.tgz, cloud-hosted full corpus, MunTTS paper and MunTTS code repository are manifestations/documentation/dependencies around one underlying corpus unless record-level provenance proves otherwise.

release_note: A discoverable corpus has been converted from a generic lead into a deterministic canonical source audit. No provider-reported count is treated as an MLHKP controlled count.
